title: Reciprocal roots have the weight-$i$ absolute value
statement:
In the situation of [prop-weight-purity], for every
$0\leq i\leq2d$ every
reciprocal root
$\alpha\in\Qlb$ of the polynomial $P_{i,\ell}$ of the
smooth-proper
cohomological family satisfies

$$
|\iota(\alpha)|=q^{i/2}.
$$

proof.text: Fix an integer $i$ with $0\leq i\leq2d$. By [prop-weil-reciprocal-roots-eigenvalues], the reciprocal roots of $P_{i,\ell}$, with algebraic multiplicity, are exactly the eigenvalues of $F_{i,\ell}\otimes1$ on $V_{i,\ell}\otimes_{\Ql}\Qlb$. The hypotheses and notation are those supplied by [prop-weight-purity] and the smooth-proper family [def-weil-smooth-proper-cohomological-family].

The scalar-extension comparison [lem-weil-cohomology-scalar-extension-qlbar] identifies $V_{i,\ell}\otimes_{\Ql}\Qlb$ with $H^i(X,\Qlb)$ and carries $F_{i,\ell}\otimes1$ to the Frobenius operator $F_{\Qlb}$. Therefore each reciprocal root $\alpha$ from Step 1 is an eigenvalue of $F_{\Qlb}$ on $H^i(X,\Qlb)$.

By [prop-weight-purity-ordinary], the Frobenius module $(H^i(X,\Qlb),F_{\Qlb})$ is $\iota$-pure of weight $i$. By the definition [def-weil-frobenius-module-weights], this means that every eigenvalue $\alpha$ satisfies $|\iota(\alpha)|=q^{i/2}$. Applying this to the reciprocal root in Step 2 proves the assertion; since $i$ was arbitrary, it holds for every $0\leq i\leq2d$.

split_report.summary: Read the imported item against the master blueprint proof and the current main-20261015 proposition, whose mathematical conclusion is the same. No Lean declaration in the reference source states this item without sorry. reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q160-eaaeffa95 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole delivery: the item prop-weight-purity-roots, which has no new nodes, all 7 cited statements, and the blueprint item and unit sk-prop-rootpurity in both master and main-20261015, where they are word for word the same. The statement is unchanged and no target is weakened. Step 1: prop-weight-purity-roots's same-unit node prop-weil-reciprocal-roots-eigenvalues says the reciprocal roots are exactly the eigenvalues of F_{i,l} tensor 1 after extension to Qlb. Step 2: the 'In particular' clause of lem-weil-cohomology-scalar-extension-qlbar makes F_{i,l} tensor 1 and F_Qlb on H^i(X,Qlb) conjugate. Its hypotheses are all fixed in prop-weight-purity, and the coefficient category is the same algebraically closed Qlb one. Step 3: prop-weight-purity-ordinary gives iota-purity of weight i, and def-weil-frobenius-module-weights turns that into |iota(alpha)|=q^{i/2}. proof_deps equals the union of the uses, and the two added stmt_deps are correct. Edge cases tested: V=0 (vacuous), d=0/i=0 (alpha=1), P^1 with i=2 (alpha=q, whereas an ordinary root would give q^{-1}), an elliptic curve with i=1, and a non-semisimple F. No cycle (no cited node's closure reaches the item), no SGA, and no duplicate (cor-zl-purity-smooth-proper, prop-zl-smooth-proper-relative-purity and prop-arithmetic-roots state different things), so same_as=[] stands. I accept the declared tool use of lem-weil-cohomology-scalar-extension-qlbar (unit sk-thm-rh): it is a generic scalar-extension comparison, independent of purity, and no node in the root-purity unit's route gives the Frobenius-equivariance. Batch 5: both listed citations reach only prop-cohomological-finiteness, the first directly and the second through the general definition def-weil-smooth-proper-cohomological-family that the blueprint already cites. That node gives finiteness, vanishing and H^0, which is a hypothesis of the trace formula and not a step of the proof of the trace formula or of Poincare duality, so nothing has to be repointed to the nt-assume leaves. Observation: the delivery left the key unit's realized fields empty (they should be statement=[prop-weight-purity-roots] and step 1 = [prop-weight-purity-roots, prop-weil-reciprocal-roots-eigenvalues, prop-weight-purity-ordinary]). I wrote no unit fix because merge_delivery.py refuses a fix to a unit file the delivery did not change; the maintainer may fill those fields. No fixes were written.
